gold.user: As a developer, I want to retrieve a list of all SIP domains associated with my Twilio account so that I can manage them effectively.
gold.ideal: The response should include an array of SIP domains with their details such as SID, friendly name, and status.

gold.user: As a developer, I want to create a new SIP domain for my Twilio account to enable SIP communication for my application.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the creation of the SIP domain and return its SID and other relevant details.

gold.user: As a developer, I want to fetch the details of a specific SIP domain using its SID to check its configuration and status.
gold.ideal: The response should provide detailed information about the specified SIP domain, including its settings and current status.

gold.user: As a developer, I want to update the settings of an existing SIP domain to modify its configuration as per my application's requirements.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the update and return the updated details of the SIP domain.

gold.user: As a developer, I want to delete a specific SIP domain that is no longer needed to keep my Twilio account organized.
